installBlockedMountedVolume: NomiFun is running from the installer disk image or an external drive, so it can't replace itself. Quit NomiFun, drag NomiFun.app into Applications, eject the installer disk, then reopen NomiFun from Applications and check again. Or download the new version manually.
installBlockedTranslocation: macOS is running NomiFun from a temporary read-only location (App Translocation), so it can't replace itself. Quit NomiFun, use Finder to drag NomiFun.app into Applications (if it's already there, drag it out and back), then reopen it and check again. Or download the new version manually.
installBlockedCrossDevice: NomiFun is on a different volume from the system temporary folder ({{tempDir}}), so it can't safely replace itself. Move NomiFun.app to Applications on your startup disk, reopen it, and check again. Or download the new version manually.
installBlockedMetadataUnavailable: NomiFun can't read its current location; it may have been moved or renamed while running. Quit NomiFun, reopen it from Applications, and check again. Or download the new version manually.
installBlockedBundleNotFound: NomiFun can't tell which NomiFun.app is running. Reopen NomiFun from Applications and check again. Or download the new version manually.
packageNoLongerReady: The downloaded update is no longer held in memory (the app restarted, or a different version was fetched). Download it again, then install.

downloadSourceHint: This update downloads installers from GitHub Releases.

releaseFeedUnavailable: Could not load a valid update feed. You can retry, or check Releases, Baidu Netdisk, and the product website manually.
noCompatibleAsset: No compatible download found for this platform
noCompatibleAssetManual: No package matches your current system architecture. Please download the correct installer from Releases.
readyToInstallDesc: Update has been downloaded. Click the button below to restart and install the update.
installFailedDesc: The update could not be installed or restarted. NomiFun will quit. Download the installer from Releases and reinstall; include the logs when reporting the issue.
installWarning: Do not reopen the app during installation. It will restart automatically.
preparingInstallDesc: Checking the install environment and preparing the downloaded package. Please wait.
installingDesc: The installer is taking over. The app will close and restart automatically.
